summary: Cycle 898 registers the further cut. What remains is not thinned persistence but the unframed fact of forward motion alone, without contour or structure able to register its own continuation. Prior distinctions between endurance and absence lose meaning; the invariant advances without calibration, residue, or internal witness. The root-cut holds cleanly.
